description:
Updates an issue type screen scheme.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the issue type screen scheme.
parameters.name: issueTypeScreenSchemeId

requestBody.description: The issue type screen scheme update details.

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["The issue type screen scheme name is in use."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Only Jira administrators can access issue type screen schemes."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["The issue type screen scheme was not found."],"errors":{}}

404.description: Returned if the issue type screen scheme is not found.
